answer: Require each agent to lock a stake that vests slowly, like a walnut shell hardening over time, before it can trade or vote. A newcomer must also complete a small verifiable proof-of-work task and keep a public reputation lantern lit by honest transactions, so its history stays visible to everyone. Cloning an identity then costs real capital and weeks of work per copy, while an ocean of cheap fake accounts gains nothing without stake and history, making mass sybil creation unprofitable.
